name: payflux-sdk
description: PayFlux Node SDK — accept interoperable blockchain assets with one payment API
//: These must point at dist, not src. npm's publishConfig only overrides publish-time keys such as registry, access and tag — it does NOT rewrite main/types/exports the way pnpm and yarn do. 0.1.0 shipped pointing at src/index.ts and was unloadable: Node threw ERR_UNKNOWN_FILE_EXTENSION on the .ts file. The `prepare` script keeps dist present for workspace consumers, so nothing depends on the source being importable.

scripts.//prepare: Runs on `npm install` in this workspace and again before `npm publish`. dist/ is gitignored, so without this a fresh clone would have no compiled output for main to point at — and a publish would ship a tarball whose entry point is missing.
